quests.instruction: Which word means a boy, described from his grandparents' point of view?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: This word is the male match to 'granddaughter'.
quests.explanation: Grandson means a boy, described from his grandparents' point of view.
quests.funFact: Grandparents often say the word 'grandson' with a big, proud smile!

quests.instruction: Which word means a girl, described from her grandparents' point of view?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: This word is the female match to 'grandson'.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter means a girl, described from her grandparents' point of view.
quests.funFact: Grandparents often say the word 'granddaughter' with a big, proud smile!

quests.instruction: Which family member might your own grandmother call her own sister?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: From your point of view, she is one generation further removed than your aunt.
quests.explanation: Great-Aunt might be called 'sister' by your own grandmother, since they are siblings.
quests.funFact: Your grandmother grew up with her own siblings, long before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which word means an uncle to your own parent, rather than an uncle to you directly?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: This relative is one whole generation further from you than a regular uncle.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle means an uncle to your own parent, rather than an uncle to you directly.
quests.funFact: Working out a relative's exact title is a fun way to practice understanding generations!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares a great-grandparent with you, but not a grandparent?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: Regular cousins share a grandparent; this relative's shared relative is one generation further back.
quests.explanation: Second Cousin shares a great-grandparent with you, but not a grandparent.
quests.funFact: Tracing back to find your second cousins is a fun challenge using a detailed family tree!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the male grandchild in a family?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: This is one specific kind of grandchild.
quests.explanation: Grandson describes the male grandchild in a family.
quests.funFact: A family can have many grandsons if each of their children has boys of their own!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the daughter of your own son or daughter?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: From her point of view, you are her grandparent.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter is the daughter of your own son or daughter.
quests.funFact: The very same girl is a granddaughter to you and a daughter to her own parents!

quests.instruction: Your grandmother's sister comes to visit. Which word describes her, from your own point of view?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: Add one extra generation of distance to the word 'aunt'.
quests.explanation: This is great-aunt rather than aunt — great-aunt is the sister of your grandparent, one generation further than a regular aunt.
quests.funFact: A great-aunt often has wonderful stories about what your grandmother was like growing up!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the brother of your grandmother or your grandfather?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: He is one generation further removed than a regular uncle.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle is the brother of your grandmother or your grandfather.
quests.funFact: A great-uncle often has wonderful stories about what your own grandparent was like growing up!

quests.instruction: Which word means a more distant cousin, connected through your grandparents' generation rather than your parents'?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: Regular cousins connect through your parents' siblings; this word connects one generation further back.
quests.explanation: Second Cousin means a more distant cousin, connected through your grandparents' generation rather than your parents'.
quests.funFact: Understanding first versus second cousins is a great way to practice reading a detailed family tree!

quests.instruction: Your daughter has a baby boy. Which word describes him, from your own point of view?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: This baby is your grandchild, one generation further than your own son.
quests.explanation: This is grandson rather than son — grandson is your child's own son, one generation further than your son.
quests.funFact: The exact same baby boy is a grandson to you and a son to your own daughter!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a girl who is often doted on by her grandparents?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: This is the girl grandparents love spoiling with extra treats.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter describes a girl who is often doted on by her grandparents.
quests.funFact: Many grandparents say spoiling a granddaughter or grandson a little is one of the joys of the role!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman even older than your aunt, from an earlier generation?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: She belongs to your grandparents' own generation.
quests.explanation: Great-Aunt is a woman even older than your aunt, from an earlier generation.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-aunt is a wonderful way to learn even more about your family's history!

quests.instruction: Which family member might your own grandfather call his own brother?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: From your point of view, he is one generation further removed than your uncle.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle might be called 'brother' by your own grandfather, since they are siblings.
quests.funFact: Your grandfather grew up with his own siblings, long before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your own age group, but even more distantly related than a regular cousin?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: The connection traces back one generation further than a regular cousin's.
quests.explanation: Second Cousin is your own age group, but even more distantly related than a regular cousin.
quests.funFact: Even distant relatives like second cousins can become close friends once they get to know each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member might proudly carry on a grandfather's own first name?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: This boy is two generations below the grandfather in question.
quests.explanation: Grandson might proudly carry on a grandfather's own first name.
quests.funFact: Naming a grandson after a grandfather is a tradition in many families around the world!

quests.instruction: Which family member is two generations below a grandparent, and is a girl?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: Count down: grandparent, then parent, then this girl.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter is two generations below a grandparent, and is a girl.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, a granddaughter is drawn two levels below her grandparent!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the woman your parent calls 'Aunt', but seen from your own generation instead?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: The very same person gets a different title depending on who is speaking.
quests.explanation: Great-Aunt describes the woman your parent calls 'Aunt', but seen from your own generation instead.
quests.funFact: Family titles often shift by one generation, depending on whose point of view you take!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man even older than your uncle, from an earlier generation?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: He belongs to your grandparents' own generation.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle is a man even older than your uncle, from an earlier generation.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-uncle is a wonderful way to learn even more about your family's history!

quests.instruction: This relative is your own age group, but more distantly related than a regular cousin, since the connection traces back through great-grandparents rather than grandparents. Which word fits best?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: Regular cousins share a grandparent; this relative shares a great-grandparent instead.
quests.explanation: This is second cousin rather than a regular cousin — a second cousin's connection traces back an extra generation, through a shared great-grandparent.
quests.funFact: The further back the shared relative, the more distant the cousin connection becomes!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the son of your own son or daughter?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: From his point of view, you are his grandparent.
quests.explanation: Grandson is the son of your own son or daughter.
quests.funFact: The very same boy is a grandson to you and a son to his own parents!

quests.instruction: Which family member might love hearing a grandmother's favorite childhood story again and again?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: This girl is two generations below the grandmother telling the story.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter might love hearing a grandmother's favorite childhood story again and again.
quests.funFact: Passing down favorite stories to a granddaughter is a treasured tradition in many families!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one generation above your aunt or uncle, and is a woman?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: Count up one more generation from a regular aunt.
quests.explanation: Great-Aunt is one generation above your aunt or uncle, and is a woman.
quests.funFact: Adding 'great-' to a family word is a simple way to show one extra generation of distance!

quests.instruction: Which word means a man who is the sibling of one of your grandparents?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: He is your grandmother's or grandfather's own brother.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle means a man who is the sibling of one of your grandparents.
quests.funFact: Great-uncles are part of your extended family, connecting you to an even wider family circle!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a cousin connection one step further out than a regular cousin?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: This word adds one extra step of distance to a regular cousin relationship.
quests.explanation: Second Cousin describes a cousin connection one step further out than a regular cousin.
quests.funFact: The word 'second' here refers to how many generations back the shared relative is!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a boy who is often doted on by his grandparents?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: Grandparents often spoil this particular grandchild with extra treats.
quests.explanation: Grandson describes a boy who is often doted on by his grandparents.
quests.funFact: Many grandparents say spoiling a grandson or granddaughter a little is one of the joys of the role!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the female grandchild in a family?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: This word names the girl version, not the boy version.
quests.explanation: Granddaughter describes the female grandchild in a family.
quests.funFact: A family can have many granddaughters if each of their children has girls of their own!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the sister of your grandmother or your grandfather?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: She is one generation further removed than a regular aunt.
quests.explanation: Great-Aunt is the sister of your grandmother or your grandfather.
quests.funFact: A great-aunt often has wonderful stories about what your own grandparent was like growing up!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the man your parent calls 'Uncle', but seen from your own generation instead?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: His title changes by one generation, depending on who is speaking.
quests.explanation: Great-Uncle describes the man your parent calls 'Uncle', but seen from your own generation instead.
quests.funFact: The very same relative can hold two different titles, depending on who in the family is speaking!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the child of your parent's own cousin?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: Your parent's cousin is one generation above this relative.
quests.explanation: Second Cousin is the child of your parent's own cousin.
quests.funFact: Second cousins share a great-grandparent, instead of sharing a grandparent like regular cousins do!
